ActVox logo, favicon and touch icon: canonical assets from the ActVox brand kit.
JetBrains Mono regular/medium: https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono (OFL.txt included).
Cabinet Grotesk and Switzer are loaded from the official Fontshare CSS API. Their proprietary font files are not redistributed in this public repository. System fonts remain available if the font CDN cannot be reached.
